answer: Slash divergent jurors, then vest every reward over 100 epochs instead of paying it once. Idle seats bleed standing each close, so a farm cannot sit on a pile of accounts and cash out. A duplicate body is caught by hash replay and forfeits whatever vesting remains. Blunt version: 1,000 seats means 1,000 vesting streams that decay if unwatched, plus juries that must agree within one point. Passive farming stops paying: the fable of the idle farm dies here, the nectar of one good epoch leaks back into the pool, and there is no cedar chest to sit on.
